constraints.name: consumer_installations_delivery_event_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (delivery_event_id) REFERENCES agent_delivery_events(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: consumer_installations_version_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (version_id) REFERENCES copilot_versions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

requiredIndexes.name: consumer_installations_delivery_event_idx
requiredIndexes.definition: CREATE INDEX consumer_installations_delivery_event_idx ON public.consumer_installations USING btree (delivery_event_id)

requiredIndexes.name: consumer_installations_version_idx
requiredIndexes.definition: CREATE INDEX consumer_installations_version_idx ON public.consumer_installations USING btree (version_id)

requiredIndexes.name: runtime_telemetry_events_verified_consumer_idx
requiredIndexes.definition: CREATE INDEX runtime_telemetry_events_verified_consumer_idx ON public.runtime_telemetry_events USING btree (agent_id, received_at DESC) WHERE ((installation_id IS NOT NULL) AND (version_verified = true))
